Drug Interactions between Proton Pump Inhibitors and Voriconazole in Patients with Pulmonary Fungal Infection
HUANG Qing⁃ru1，2 ，DING Shui⁃lian3 ，Chen Ting⁃ting1∗ （1. Quanzhou First Hospital Affiliated to Fujian Medi⁃cal University，Quanzhou 362000，China；2. Haidu Hospital，Nan′an 362300，China；3. Guangze County Hos⁃pital，Nanping 354100，China）ABSTRACT：OBJECTIVE The effect of proton pump inhibitors on voriconazole valley concentration in patients with pulmonary fungal infection was studied retrospectively. METHODS Information was collected from patients treated with voriconazole at Izumi between June 2022 and December 2023. The general data，proton pump inhibitor administration schedule，voriconazole administration schedule，other drug regimens with interaction and voriconazole treatment monitoring data were summarized. According to the combination of voriconazole and proton pump inhibitor， they were divided into voriconazole monotherapy group and voriconazole combined proton pump inhibitor group. The difference of voriconazole valley concentration between the two groups and the influencing factors of voriconazole valley concentration were analyzed. RESULTS Comparing the voriconazole valley concentration between the two groups，the median voriconazole valley concentration in the combination group was slightly higher than that in the monotherapy group，but there was no statistical difference between the two groups. By stratified analysis of the types of proton pump inhibitors，it was found that the median voriconazole valley concentration in omeprazole group was higher than that in rabeprazole group when omeprazole，rabeprazole and voriconazole were combined. Meanwhile，the proportion of subtherapeutic concentration in the combined drug group was lower than that in the single drug group. CONCLUSION Proton pump inhibitors can increase voriconazole valley concentration to some extent.肺部侵袭性真菌病的主要致病菌为曲霉菌对于免疫功能低下的个体而言，此类疾病的死亡率相对较高〔1〕。 伏立康唑作为侵袭性真菌感染治疗的一线用药〔2〕 临床首选用于侵袭性曲霉病非粒细胞缺乏患者念珠菌血症及念珠菌属所致播散性皮肤感染腹部肾脏膀胱壁及伤口感染等严重真菌感染〔3〕 伏立康唑通过肝细胞色素酶代谢〔4〕 与多种药物存在相互作用在实际临床应用中住院患者特别是血液病患者的酸相关疾病发生率较高并且伏立康唑胃肠道不良反应中很常见腹泻呕吐腹痛恶心等〔6〕 因此临床上伏立康唑与质子泵抑制剂（Proton Pump Inhibitors，PPIs）的联用较为常见。 自 1989年奥美拉唑上市以来市场上已有种可供选择这些PPIs 通过肝细胞色素 P450（ CYP2C19、3A4、⁃2B6、⁃2D6、⁃2C9、⁃2C8和⁃1A2）进行广泛代谢，且 CYP2C19 表型对其药代动力学和临床结果有显著影响〔7〕。 目前有较多研究显示 PPIs 与伏立康唑共同给药会增加伏立康唑的血药谷浓度〔12，13，27⁃29〕。然而，低伏立康唑暴露与曲霉病患者预后不良相关，而高伏立康唑暴露与毒性风险增加相关包括视觉障碍转氨酶水平升高等因此优化伏立康唑的使用和暴露非常重要〔8〕 本文通过回顾性研究伏立康唑血药谷浓度（ Voriconazole TroughConcentration， $\mathrm { V O R - C } _ { \mathrm { m i n } } \mathrm { ~ ) }$ ，探索在肺部真菌感染患者中 PPIs对 $\mathrm { V O R - C } _ { \mathrm { m i n } }$ 的影响，以及两者相互作用的影响因素，为两者相互作用的研究提供更多的临床数据通讯作者陈婷婷女职称副主任药师研究方向临床药学
